description: Apply a non-empty fields object to an existing record by sobject + id. This is a write action. Returns immediately with a job_id and status 'queued' (D0.3 deferred-completion shape) -- the dispatch returning is NOT the same as the update being applied; the confirmation is delivered when the job completes.
embedding_description: Update fields on a Salesforce CRM record that already exists, using its object type, record id, and a non-empty field-value object. Applies the requested values in place to a known Account, Contact, Opportunity, or custom object -- the single-record field-maintenance write. Dispatched asynchronously: job_id first, applied-confirmation later.

result_processor_customizations.result_description: Dispatch envelope: job_id (string) and status ('queued'). This is NOT confirmation the fields were applied -- the success flag arrives separately, as its own message, when the job completes.
result_processor_customizations.presentation_guidance: This call only confirms the update was queued -- do not present job_id/status as proof the fields changed. Acknowledge the request is in flight; the applied-confirmation lands in a follow-up message when the job completes. Once delivered, confirm the update; low sensitivity (flag only, data_sensitivity 0.0).

error_processor_customizations.error_interpretation: sf.invalid_params: missing sobject, id, or an empty/missing fields object. sf.not_found: no record with that id exists. sf.malformed_query: a field value was rejected. sf.permission_denied: the CLI's authenticated user cannot update this record.
error_processor_customizations.recovery_guidance: sf.not_found: verify the id and sobject via soql_query or get_record. sf.malformed_query: check valid values via describe_sobject.
